loop.title: Loop
loop.intro: ecentic reads your Loop return reasons and finds products where shoppers expected something different from what they got. We check what AI assistants tell shoppers about those products, fix the product data they read, and show you whether returns on those products went down.
loop.readOnly: ecentic only reads returns. It never processes, cancels or changes a return.
loop.privacy: Only this store’s returns are used. Customer details are discarded and comments are redacted before analysis.
loop.stepOne: In Loop Admin, open Returns Management → Tools & integrations → Developer Tools → Generate API key.
loop.stepTwo: Select only the returns and developer_tools scopes, then generate the key.
loop.stepThree: Copy the API key and the webhook signing secret from Developer Tools into the fields below.
loop.notConfigured: Loop connection is not configured on this installation.
loop.actionFailed: Could not update Loop. Check your connection details and try again. For disconnect or deletion, sign in again if your session is no longer recent.
loop.cleanupRequired: Local access has stopped. Remove ecentic’s webhook subscriptions in Loop Developer Tools to finish cleanup.
loop.disconnectBody: This stops sync and removes your saved credentials immediately. Detailed return data is deleted within 30 days. Previously reported product counts remain available.
loop.deleteBody: This disconnects Loop and immediately deletes its return details, reason mappings, comments and unpublished suggestions. Previously reported product counts remain available.
loop.rotateBody: Paste the new secret after rotating it in Loop. The previous secret is accepted during the rotation overlap.
loop.signalsIntro: Expectation gaps with enough return evidence to review, ordered by the value of data-fixable returns.
loop.empty: No expectation gaps meet the evidence threshold yet.
loop.gap: {share} of this product’s returned items have this gap ({count} items).
loop.exchange: In {count} of {total} comparable exchanges, shoppers chose the next size up.
loop.noAnswers: AI answers have not been checked yet.
loop.fitApproval: This fit note comes from return data. Review and approve it before publishing.
loop.approveBody: The exact change shown below will be published to your connected store. Confirm that every product fact is accurate.
loop.denominatorMissing: Return rates are unavailable because ordered-unit data is not connected. Counts and gap shares are shown instead.
loop.noControl: No suitable control products were available.
loop.knownAiNote: Only orders with a verified checkout marker are included. Marker coverage currently depends on the Recharge connection.
loop.mappingsIntro: Adjust how this store’s return reasons are interpreted. Your choices take priority over automatic classification.
loop.noMappings: Reason categories appear after your first sync.
loop.fixable: Product data can help address this reason
loop.mixedValue: Affected returns use different currencies; no combined value is shown.
loop.collecting: The after-publication window is still collecting data. Its counts are not yet comparable with a complete baseline window.
loop.secretRequired: Add your webhook signing secret to finish connecting Loop.
loop.excludedControls: {count} control products were removed because their product data changed after this comparison began.
